Title: Mixed Cart — Single-Currency Cart Yields cartTotals With Exactly One Element
Preconditions: Runner-native. ORG_USER (standard USD-only user). Add one USD item to a freshly-cleared cart. Query cartTotals. Assert: exactly one element with isDefaultTotalCurrency=true. No PTS or other foreign-currency element should be present in a single-currency cart.
Assertions:
[ERRORS label=check_totals] errors[] empty
[COUNT label=check_totals] data.cart.cartTotals = 1
[DATA label=check_totals] data.cart.cartTotals.0.isDefaultTotalCurrency = true
[DATA label=check_totals] data.cart.cartTotals.0.total is non-null
[DATA label=check_totals] data.cart.cartTotals.0.total.currency.code is non-null
Cross_Layer_Checks: [EVIDENCE] Single-currency cart produces cartTotals with exactly 1 element — not 0, not 2+. isDefaultTotalCurrency=true on that element.
Failure_Signals: cartTotals is null or empty (field not available — schema regression); cartTotals has 2+ elements for a single-currency cart (ghost currency leak); isDefaultTotalCurrency=false on the only element
References: VCST-5101; BL-GQL-001; Mixed Cart cartTotals single-currency edge case
